name: Dumbbell Decline Triceps Extension
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, secure your legs under the pads, and lie back.
Extend both dumbbells above your shoulders with palms facing each other and upper arms steady.
Bend your elbows under control to lower the dumbbells beside your temples or ears.
Extend both elbows to press the dumbbells back above your shoulders.
tips: Keep your upper arms steady while your forearms move.
Avoid letting your elbows flare wide and keep your wrists straight.
